# Conversion Calculator Plus

> Official website of the iPhone and iPad unit, currency and crypto converter, published by Adysseus.

The app covers 72 categories and 685 non-currency units. It includes Simple and Carousel modes, an expression calculator, Currency+, saved currency charts, conversion history and favorites. Currency+ refreshes rates every minute while its rates page is open, the app is active and it is connected; offline use relies on previously loaded data. Currency History offers 1-day through all-available-history charts, point inspection and range extrema. Chart controls include pinch zoom on both axes, two-finger panning and double-tap reset; one finger still selects readings. Interactive widgets and Siri require optional Premium. The free app has banner ads and no full-page ads. It does not execute transfers or crypto trades.

The 11-competitor table follows Apple's public US iPhone storefront search for “conversion calculator”, observed on 2026-10-26. Missing listing details are unverified, not absent. Currency checks are not accuracy benchmarks. Unit totals, category totals and conversion-pair counts are different measures. The matching structured records preserve source URLs and these qualifications.

## Editorial context
Comparisons are written by the app publisher. They are not independent rankings or hands-on test results. Competitor product claims have dated primary-source links. Testimonials are selected short excerpts with public reviewer names and dates. Quotes and currency rates can be dated; read the surrounding qualifications.
